newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK families clash with knives over shared toilet.
newsitem.headline: HK families clash with knives over shared toilet.

text.p: A 13-year-old Hong Kong girl got her finger sliced off when families attacked each other with kitchen knives in a quarrel over a toilet shared by four families in a slum apartment, newspapers said on Wednesday.
The girl's 41-year-old mother was seriously cut and her 14-month-old baby sister was spattered in blood by the time police arrived, the Apple Daily and other newspapers said.
Newspaper pictures showed the combatants with blood all over their clothes amid a scene of devastation.
The police overpowered an enraged man when they arrived at the flat in Kwun Tong, a working class industrial district on the Kowloon peninsula, the newspaper said.
The apartment, like the homes of many poor people in Hong Kong, was shared by four families -- one family per room.
